_about: A work permit filed on its own (Form I-765, src/work_permit.py), per the I-765 Instructions and uscis.gov/i-765: the G-28 and the I-765, two passport photos, a copy of the I-94 or passport, the evidence of the category (the I-485 or I-589 receipt, the asylum approval, the deferred action notice), the current card for a renewal, and court dispositions for a (c)(8) applicant ever arrested. The attorney approves titles and order.
title: I-765 (work permit)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: Two identical color passport-style photos, taken in the last 30 days; the client's name and A-Number lightly in pencil on the back.
A first (c)(8) asylum work permit, or a (c)(8) renewal: the Pub. L. 119-21 fee is its own payment (its own Form G-1450 or G-1650), separate from any filing fee.

exhibits.title: The category: the I-485 or I-589 receipt notice, the asylum approval, or the deferred action notice
The current work permit (front and back): a renewal or replacement
Form I-94, the passport identity page, or another government photo ID
Certified court dispositions for every arrest or conviction ((c)(8))
